per_row.label: answer
turns: Do I get sport compensation?
replies: Yes, as a part-time employee in the Lviv office, you are eligible for sport compensation. This covers gym memberships, swimming pools, sport classes, and sport club fees. To claim it, you need to submit your receipt by the 25th of the month, and the compensation will be paid with your next salary. Note that unused amounts do not accumulate.

per_row.label: clarify_then_answer
turns: Do I need a sick note?
4 days
replies: How many working days have you been (or will you be) ill?

Yes, you need a sick note because your illness duration is 4 consecutive working days, which exceeds the 3-day limit for taking sick leave without a medical certificate. You will need to register your sick leave through the HR assistant, and it will be sent for HR review to confirm the certificate and approve your request.

per_row.label: clarify_then_answer
turns: Can I work from abroad?
Three weeks in Croatia
replies: For how many days do you plan to work from abroad?

Yes, you can work from abroad for up to 30 calendar days per calendar year. Since you plan to work for three weeks (21 days) in Croatia, you are within the limit. However, you must notify HR at least 10 working days before your departure and confirm that Croatia is not under sanctions and that you have a stable internet connection.

per_row.label: clarify_then_answer
turns: Can I get money back for something I bought for work?
A taxi home at 23:30 after a release
replies: What did you buy for work?

Yes, you can get reimbursed for your taxi ride home after working past 22:00. The reimbursement is up to 400 UAH per ride for office-based employees like you. Make sure to keep the receipt for your claim.

turns: How many days per week can I work from home?
And can I get the coworking allowance?
replies: As a full-time employee in the Lviv office, you can work from home up to 3 days per week, provided you have an agreement with your team lead. Additionally, your team may establish one common office day each week.

As a full-time employee based in the Lviv office, you are not eligible for the coworking allowance, as this is only available to fully remote employees. Since you have access to an office, this allowance does not apply to you.
